data.name: Dheeksah
data.gender_notes: Dheeksah is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dheeksah is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘dheeksha’, which means ‘receiving’. The name is associated with the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi, and represents the act of receiving blessings and prosperity. The name is often given to girls to bless them with abundance and good fortune. The name Dheeksah carries the meaning “Goddess of wealth and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dheeksah usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the graceful reception of blessings and prosperity.
data.etymology: Dheeksah belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of wealth and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dheeksah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
